definitions.gloss: description; narration; account (in writing or speech)
definitions.explanation: Setting out events, facts or thoughts in order, in words; used of writing, history and literary analysis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{叙述|じょじゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一人称|いちにんしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{叙述|じょじゅつ}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This novel is narrated in the first person.

examples.japanese: {歴史書|れきししょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{叙述|じょじゅつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{書|か}き{手|て}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: How a history book tells events depends on the writer's standpoint.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{客観的|きゃっかんてき}→客観的：05696_kyakkanteki⟧な{叙述|じょじゅつ}: objective description
- ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{叙述|じょじゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set out the facts
- {叙述|じょじゅつ}⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧: descriptive or narrative sentence (in grammar)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記述|きじゅつ}→記述：05819_kijutsu⟧: description, write-up; a plain record of facts, as in answer sheets and reports
- ⟦{描写|びょうしゃ}→描写：05516_byousha⟧: depiction; vivid portrayal of scenes and feelings
{叙述|じょじゅつ} stresses telling things in sequence, and belongs to written, academic style.
